Congress has been running race-based caucuses and organizations for decades and calling it inclusion. The Congressional Black Caucus. The Hispanic Caucus. The Asian Pacific American Caucus.

Checking skin color at the door or advocating for Americans of one race over another is not inclusion and it never was.

Our resolution calls it what it is and shuts it down for good.

For decades, Americans were told processed foods and ingredients were perfectly fine.

Now, under Secretary Kennedy’s leadership, we’re asking the questions Americans deserve answers to: What’s actually in our food? What are we putting in our bodies?

The MAHA movement is putting American health first and demanding answers. We’re all in.

Real food. Real ingredients. Make America Healthy Again.

We helped secure nearly $2 million for Joint Base Charleston and Charleston County to expand unmanned aircraft systems (UAS) capabilities across Berkeley, Charleston, and Dorchester Counties.

This investment grows the base's Drone Operations Management System, ensuring drone programs operate in coordination with the U.S. Air Force and the FAA.
